plate_comment: The LSG reference speed task (cm848_periodicTaskSet_sensorProcessing): sets low_speed_governor_shift_in_process_hold_passes, then runs cm848_calculateLowSpeedGovernorCoolantTemperatureSpeed, cm848_selectLowSpeedGovernorDesiredReferenceSpeed and cm848_slewLowSpeedGovernorReferenceSpeed (e2m 14EE / 1496) (was cm848_updateGovernorSpeedLimits)

low_speed_governor_coolant_temperature_speed_request from the coolant temperature table (or a step lookup with hysteresis), zeroed outside park / neutral unless enabled, after low_speed_governor_cold_idle_time of cold idling, during the hot idle inhibit time and after low_speed_governor_hot_idle_time at that speed (e2m 14EE +0..+8) (was cm848_updateSpeedLimitFromCoolant)

Picks low_speed_governor_desired_reference_speed as the largest of the LSG speed requests and records the winner in low_speed_governor_reference.reference_speed_state (e2m 1496 +14: 5 BASE low_speed_governor_base_reference_speed_cal / 0 COOLANT / 1 PARK_NEU / 2 EXTENDED / 3 AC / 4 J1850 / 9 ALTITUDE / 11 TOOL / 12 MOVING; 10 SIP holds the speed during a shift; 6 JCOMM = a J1939 TSC1 override). It also computes the park or drive, A/C, J1850, extended idle, altitude, tool and moving requests, and the high pressure safety valve test state (was cm848_calculateProtectionSpeedLimits)

Moves low_speed_governor_reference.reference_speed toward the desired speed by the increment / decrement rates (only in park or neutral at rest unless enabled, and not around the tool speed), then clamps it to low_speed_governor_minimum_idle_speed (state 7) and _maximum_idle_speed (state 8; the tool speed to low_speed_governor_maximum_tool_idle_speed). Writes the reference before droop, the extended idle status and the shift in process timer (was cm848_applySpeedLimitConstraints)

The LSG error terms (e2m 14EF / 14F0): the adjusted reference speed (the reference before droop minus 0x40aedc, clamped), the speed error x low_speed_governor_error_filter_gain >> 9 through low_speed_governor_error_filter and its +-8000 clamps into low_speed_governor_filtered_speed_error, then its derivative and jerk terms (was cm848_calculateSpeedRateLimiting)

Boot initializer (cm848_applicationMain) of the LSG reference speed chain: the lookup caches, the timers and first-pass flags, the base reference copy at 0x3faf7c, the state 5 (BASE), and the J1939 TSC1 override control mode (off) (was cm848_initGovernorStateVariables)

low_speed_governor_reference.no_load_fuel (e2m 1496 +12 No_Load_Fuel_At_LSG_Ref): fuel_demand_base_offset, or (outside low speed governor final gain states 0 / 1) the friction fuel at the reference before droop + the fuel by throttle table + the coolant friction adjustment + governor_speed_target_trim (was cm848_calculateGovernorCompensation)
